svg.text: The Biggest Legal Jump Is The Second Truck, When You Become An Employer
1 truck · You drive, book and bill
Set up: ABN, GST from $75,000 turnover, rego, insurance, cost per km
2 trucks · You become an employer and a scheduler
Set up: payroll, super, workers comp, the award, fatigue and defects
5 trucks · You stop driving full time
Set up: depot, dispatcher, telematics, SMS, the accreditation choice
Mixed fleet · Vans and cars join the trucks
Set up: a second rule book for vans at or under 4.5 t GVM
Set up: warehouse lease, WMS, storage pricing, payroll tax
